description: Shared tfa_code rejection, the confirm POST body, and the preview that redacts the code while naming what confirming turns on. The response carries the account-recovery scratch code and its expiry, which the envelope decodes.

cases.name: rejects missing tfa_code
cases.expect_error: tfa_code must be a non-empty string

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This enables two-factor authentication for the profile. Set confirm=true to proceed.

side_effects: Two-factor authentication is enabled for this profile.
